breakage.symptom: Error: Route generator shape changed; validation injection is stale. Thrown on every run, before any map was generated.
breakage.cause: injectValidationSurface rewrote two exact statements inside generateMaze to force a template and publish metadata. Both anchors were deleted by the buildCandidate/recovery-sweep refactor of an earlier mission:
deadAnchors: if (map && isValidMap(map, difficulty, routeStage)) return map;
breakage.impact: The 2160-map route validation harness was dead tooling. Nothing detected it, because a validator that throws on startup looks the same as a validator nobody ran.
breakage.notCausedBy: Not a consequence of the star-selection fix; production was already correct.

repair.approach: No function body is patched any more. The generator is exposed through an append-only export surface, and the harness drives buildCandidate + isValidMap itself — which is where template and exit are chosen anyway, so both become observable and forceable by construction.
changes: injectValidationSurface -> buildExportSurface: appends `export const __routeValidation = {...}` and nothing else. A binding that disappears fails with its own name in the message.

harnessGenerate: mirrors production's two phases (randomised search, then the bounded deterministic recovery sweep), both ending at the same isValidMap. Throws rather than returning an uncertified map, exactly like production.

checkGenerationFidelity: the replacement for the string anchor. Runs harnessGenerate and the real generateMaze from the same seed and requires an identical map. Behavioural equivalence, not text matching.

generate(): now records a generation throw instead of crashing the run. Production throws by design, so a seed that exhausts every gate is an observation the validator must report — crashing on it hid the very thing the tool exists to measure.

coverage.note: Every route x mode x template combination was exercised through the forced-template path; unforced runs sample templates by chance.

observations: Zero map validation errors across 156 maps: every map the generator certified also satisfies the validator's independent re-check.

All six generation throws are on route 3, the stage with the corner portal — consistent with the routeCellsHaveEscape analysis in route-cells-have-escape-contract.md. They are production's designed failure mode, not a tool defect.
fallbackMaps is structurally 0 now: the uncertified fallback path no longer exists in the generator.
